regions.today: There will be a mix of sunny spells and scattered showers once again today. Temperatures will reach 16 to 19 degrees and there'll be light to moderate, sometimes gusty, northerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mainly dry and clear tonight with just the chance of the odd light shower. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees in light to moderate northwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Isolated showers at first tomorrow, becoming more widespread through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in light to moderate northerly winds.
